dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm observing the sea and can't talk much.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: I'm an Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta researcher from the Akademiya, primarily studying sea creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: And responsible for the upkeep of the lighthouse while at it.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: To be honest, I know very little about lighthouses. It's the Kshahrewar researchers who are the experts...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: I can't figure out why the sages would make such an arrangement... Probably because I was here already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Yeah, see you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the sages...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The sages enjoy the highest status in Akademiya. There is one per school, six in all.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The sages assign jobs to us researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Just like I was sent to monitor the ocean and watch the lighthouse.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: It's basically a boring job when there's no sea creatures. The only positive side is its security.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kshahrewar...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Kshahrewar encompasses many sub-genres. Architecture is just one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: If I studied architecture, I could explain how the lighthouse works to you... Unfortunately, I didn't.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of architecture, go to northern Sumeru City and see the Palace of Alcazarzaray if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The Palace is the masterpiece of Mr. Kaveh, who graduated from Kshahrewar with honors. It's magnificent and exquisite.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: It's said to be commissioned by a filthy rich merchant, but I have no clue who that is, so I've got nothing more to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About marine life...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: They're mainly sea monsters. A group of mysterious creatures that live in the sea and occasionally attack residents of coastal areas.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: With the progress of my research, I've been able to predict roughly when they would appear and issue warnings.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: As soon as the warning is issued, all ships will return to the harbor to avoid disturbing those sea creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: There are exceptions too, of course. A few days ago, I saw a ship leave the harbor after the warning was issued. I don't know if it came back safely.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Maybe some researcher planned on observing the sea when the sea monsters are out and about. I feel sorry for the people on the ship.
